Statements marked with * are scored in reverse.' Grzegorzewska, Kleka & Felinska, 'Achieving mental wellness in school-aged children: Validating a questionnaire to measure developmental task completion (QADT)'. The appendix labels the items DT_1..DT_12 and the data ZR_1..ZR_12; the deposit's own analysis code uses the two interchangeably (a comment reading '# moved DT_2' sits above a model that moves ZR_2). The line 'Zycie szkolne jest:' / 'School life is:' is printed once, in the appendix table's header row above DT_1, so it is shipped as a section_prompt shared by all twelve items rather than as any one item's stem; the items themselves have no stems, only the A/B statements, so item_text is blank.
